main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads n, m, an array a, and m union pairs, builds a union-find forest, counts connected components, and prints either 0, Impossible, the total sum of a, or a minimum-cost sum formed from component minima plus the smallest remaining a values after sorting." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: int "Always 0 after the selected output path completes."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Declare integer variables i, j, k, n, and m. RESULT i, j, k, n, m]
            [COMMAND Read two integers from standard input into n and m. RESULT n, m]
            [COMMAND Declare integer variables x and y, and arrays uni and a of length n. RESULT x, y, uni, a]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, read one integer from standard input into a[i]. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, set uni[i] = i. RESULT uni]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to m-1 inclusive, read two integers from standard input into x and y. RESULT x, y]
            [COMMAND Within the same outer for loop over i, if uni[x] != x, then declare local variable t, save t = uni[y], set uni[y] = x, follow uni pointers starting from y until reaching a root j, set uni[y] = j, and then for each index j2 from 0 to n-1 inclusive except y, if uni[j2] == t, set uni[j2] = uni[y]. RESULT uni, t]
            [COMMAND Within the same outer for loop over i, if uni[x] == x, then declare local variable t, save t = uni[x], set uni[x] = y, follow uni pointers starting from x until reaching a root j, set uni[x] = j, and then for each index j2 from 0 to n-1 inclusive except x, if uni[j2] == t, set uni[j2] = uni[x]. RESULT uni, t]
            [COMMAND After the union loop, set num = 0, then for i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, if uni[i] == i, increment num by 1. RESULT num]
            [COMMAND If num == 1, print 0 to standard output and return 0 immediately. RESULT stdout, return_value]
            [COMMAND If num * 2 - 2 > n, print the text Impossible to standard output and return 0 immediately. RESULT stdout, return_value]
            [COMMAND If num * 2 - 2 == n, set t = 0, sum a[i] for i from 0 to n-1 inclusive into t, print t as an integer, and return 0 immediately. RESULT stdout, return_value]
            [COMMAND If none of the preceding early-return conditions was taken, declare arrays min and minn of length n. RESULT min, minn]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, set min[i] = inf, where inf is the sentinel value used by the original code. RESULT min]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, if min[uni[i]] is strictly greater than a[i], set minn[uni[i]] = i and min[uni[i]] = a[i]. RESULT min, minn]
            [COMMAND Set ssum = 0 and tnum = num - 2. RESULT ssum, tnum]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, set local variable y = inf; if min[i] is not equal to y, add min[i] to ssum as a long long value and set a[minn[i]] = inf. RESULT ssum, a]
            [COMMAND Sort array a in place using qsort with n elements, each of size sizeof(int), and the comparator compare. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to tnum-1 inclusive, add a[i] to ssum. RESULT ssum]
            [COMMAND Print ssum as a long long integer to standard output. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND Return 0 from the function. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
